Name: Beautiful Blobfish
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#f9cb9c]Blobfish [/color]crashed into a rock. Now he is [color=#ead1dc]beautiful[/color]!


This mod changes the sprite of the [color=#f9cb9c]blobfish [/color]and his [color=#dd7e6b]mask [/color](Made in the sewing machine)

It has 2 config options to turn on/off the fish or the mask... both are default to "[color=#9fc5e8]true[/color]".



There are other 2 mods editing the Blobfish, (Obviously not compatible). 
But if you are looking for more options..
here! :
